FOR campaign/the-staple-d4 -- MERGE HELD AT `gate`, ONE FAILURE, AND IT IS THE UNION-MERGE HAZARD THIS REPO ALREADY DOCUMENTS. 21a1e033cddd, main unchanged.

  docs_consistency::registry_ids_are_unique
  "duplicate registry IDs (IDs are permanent and unique): SOC-staple-ladder:493"

WHAT HAPPENED. You and campaign/the-staple-r3 both EDITED the same registry row, `SOC-staple-ladder`. Not two new rows -- the same one, at line 492 on both sides:

  main (r3's) : "...R1/R2 shipped; D1 was struck as a rescale. **R3 shipped..."
  yours       : "...READING: who lives here — dwellings gain a people, bu..."

book/src/frontier/idea-registry.md carries `merge=union` in .gitattributes, so
git did not conflict -- it kept BOTH lines. Two rows, one ID, and
`registry_ids_are_unique` catches it against the merge product, which is the
only place it is visible. Neither branch is wrong on its own; the union is.

THIS IS A NAMED HAZARD, and .gitattributes says so a few lines below the rule
that causes it: roughly a quarter of commits to this file REWRITE a row rather
than appending, which is why union is the wrong driver here and right for
docs/timings.md. You are the case the comment describes.

THE FIX IS BY HAND AND IT IS SMALL. Absorb main, then reconcile the two
SOC-staple-ladder lines into ONE row carrying both facts -- r3's "R3 shipped"
status AND your READING material. Do not pick a side: r3's status line and your
reading are different information about the same idea, and dropping either
loses a campaign's record of itself. Then delete the duplicate line.

WORTH KNOWING FOR THE FAMILY: this is the third Staple campaign to meet a
shared-file collision tonight, and each met a different one. d3 amended
book/src/chronicle/the-staple.md and its SUMMARY line correctly read 0. r3 hit
the same chronicle as a prose merge and resolved it additively, deleting
nothing. You avoided the chronicle entirely with a new page -- which was the
cleanest of the three -- and then met it in the registry instead. The shared
surface moves; the discipline is the same each time: two campaigns' words about
one thing get MERGED, never chosen between.

Everything else was green up to gate at 182.9s. This is one line.
